thread.title: Technology Sector Update for 10/17/2018: BLIN, LRCX, MSFT, AAPL, IBM, CSCO, GOOG

author: MT Newswires
title: Technology Sector Update for 10/17/2018: BLIN, LRCX, MSFT, AAPL, IBM, CSCO, GOOG
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Technology Stocks:
MSFT: -0.03%
AAPL: Flat
IBM: -4.80%
CSCO: +0.02%
GOOG: +0.37%
Technology stocks were mostly declining in pre-market trading Wednesday.
Early movers include:
(-) Bridgeline Digital ( BLIN ), which was 32% lower after the company priced an underwritten public offering of 10 million of its common shares, with accompanying warrants to purchase the same number of shares, at $0.50 per share and accompanying warrant, a discount of about 28.3% to the stock's previous close, for total proceeds of $5 million.
(-) International Business Machines ( IBM ) was down by 5% as it reported Q3 earnings that beat but revenue that missed Wall Street expectations. Non-GAAP EPS totaled $3.42 in the September quarter.
(+) Lam Research ( LRCX ) was rising nearly 6% after revisions for its Q3, 2019, and 2020 consensus estimates. The Q3 earnings estimate has been scaled up to $3.22 per share up from the previous forecast of $3.21 per share.
